summary: MindsHub (by MindsDB, Inc.) has an always-free tier with no subscription and no credit card. The MindsHub Air model (a general-purpose model alias, API alias mindshub_air) and TypeSafe's Jev decision model (API alias jev, via the Decisions API) are free within fair use, both in MindsHub Agents and through the API. Daily rate limits apply and are not published as numbers. The free tier is meant for people using agents. Bulk pipelines, scripted volume traffic, scraping, reselling, or multiple accounts are not covered and can lead to suspension. Air is an alias MindsHub can repoint to a different model. Use outside the free tier is billed at published per-model rates.
claim_steps: Create a free MindsHub account at mindshub.ai (no credit card required)
Use the MindsHub Air model in MindsHub Agents, or call it through Unified Inference with the alias mindshub_air
Use Jev through the Decisions API with the alias jev and your MindsHub key
